lines.zh: 我贴着凉水逆流摆尾，鳞上虹光一闪。
lines.en: I beat my tail upstream, rainbow along my flank.

lines.zh: 溪底的卵石从我腹下一条条滑过去。
lines.en: River stones slide past one by one beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那条同伴，不离它的尾鳍。
lines.en: I follow the trout ahead, never leaving its tail fin.

lines.zh: 拐弯时我侧过身，让水从鳃边挤过。
lines.en: Rounding the bend I tilt, letting water squeeze past my gills.

lines.zh: 五条影子一起穿过桥洞下的暗水。
lines.en: Five shadows cross together beneath the dark water of the bridge.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙脊游，肚子差点擦到河床。
lines.en: I swim along the sand ridge, belly almost scraping bottom.

lines.zh: 水一凉，我就往下沉半尺。
lines.en: When the water cools, I sink half a foot.

lines.zh: 我在这道弯里来回巡，像在量河的长度。
lines.en: I patrol this bend as if measuring the river's length.

lines.zh: 同伴掉头，我也跟着掉头。
lines.en: My schoolmate turns back, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴压低，从倒木底下钻过去。
lines.en: I drop my tail and slip under the fallen log.

lines.zh: 水面结着薄冰，我在冰下慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: Thin ice seals the surface; I sway slowly beneath it.

lines.zh: 春水涨了，我往上游的浅滩挪。
lines.en: Spring water rises, so I move to the upstream shallows.

lines.zh: 我躲在石头背水的一面，省些力气。
lines.en: I hide on the stone's lee side to save my strength.

lines.zh: 一摆尾，我换了个方向，虹彩跟着翻面。
lines.en: One flick turns me, and my rainbow flips over.

lines.zh: 我从石缝钻出来，鳞带泥。
lines.en: I slip from the rocks, scales muddy.

lines.zh: 一只水獭在岸上盯着我们。
lines.en: An otter watches us from the bank.

lines.zh: 我顺着水草边挪了几尺。
lines.en: I slide a few feet along the weeds.

lines.zh: 天黑前我们得游到下游。
lines.en: We must reach downstream before dark.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草间，只让鳃一开一合。
lines.en: I hang among the weeds, letting only my gills move.

lines.zh: 水流推我半寸，我又摆尾挪回来。
lines.en: The current nudges me an inch; I flick back into place.

lines.zh: 我在石缝口停住，看水里的光斑晃。
lines.en: I stop at the crevice and watch the light spots sway.

lines.zh: 冬天水冷，我几乎不动，只慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: Winter water is cold; I barely move and just breathe.

lines.zh: 一片落叶沉下来，我让开了一点。
lines.en: A leaf sinks down and I shift slightly aside.

lines.zh: 午后的阳光照到浅底，我悬着不动。
lines.en: Afternoon sun reaches the shallows; I hang still.

lines.zh: 我嘴一张一合，尝出水里一点铁味。
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes, tasting iron in the water.

lines.zh: 河里没别的动静，只剩我这圈涟漪。
lines.en: Nothing else stirs; only my own ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 我把身子斜着，虹带在水里显得更亮。
lines.en: I tilt my body so the rainbow stripe catches light.

lines.zh: 三条同伴停在我后面，一起都不动。
lines.en: Three schoolmates halt behind me and all go still.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，等一只落水的小虫。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, waiting for a fallen insect.

lines.zh: 水面被风刮皱，我看不清上面了。
lines.en: Wind wrinkles the surface and I can no longer see above.

lines.zh: 我轻轻吐了串泡，看它们往上散。
lines.en: I release a thread of bubbles and watch them rise.

lines.zh: 我把头朝下游摆着，懒得逆流。
lines.en: I point my head downstream, too lazy to fight the current.

lines.zh: 我隔着水面看你，先看见你的影子。
lines.en: I see your shadow first, before I see you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上不动，我却已经转向你。
lines.en: You stand still on the bank, yet I turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我游到浅处，露出半张脸看你。
lines.en: I come to the shallows and show you half my face.

lines.zh: 我眼里映着你的轮廓，水面把它摇碎。
lines.en: Your shape is in my eye; ripples break it apart.

lines.zh: 你一蹲下，我就退到石头后面。
lines.en: When you crouch, I retreat behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，吸一口外面的空气。
lines.en: I lift my head out and take one breath of air.

lines.zh: 你的竿影落在水上，我一直盯着它。
lines.en: Your rod's shadow falls on the water; I keep staring.

lines.zh: 我绕着你岸边的脚游了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half a turn around your feet at the bank.

lines.zh: 你手里那根线在动，我跟着它转头。
lines.en: The line in your hand moves; my head follows it.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，直到同伴把我撞走。
lines.en: I watch you long, until a schoolmate bumps me away.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我转头就跑。
lines.en: Blood clouds the water; I turn and flee.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，伤口凉得发疼。
lines.en: A scale comes off and the wound stings cold.

lines.zh: 我被打得贴到水底，又挣扎起来。
lines.en: The blow pins me to the bottom; I struggle up.

lines.zh: 这伤不重，可我不敢再靠近。
lines.en: The wound is light, but I dare not come close.

lines.zh: 我的虹带断了一截，颜色也暗了。
lines.en: My rainbow stripe is broken and its color dims.

lines.zh: 我往石头缝里钻，尾巴还露在外面。
lines.en: I dive into a crevice with my tail still showing.

lines.zh: 血味让我慌，我撞了两次石头。
lines.en: The smell of my blood panics me; I hit two rocks.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴喘水，吞下的全是血。
lines.en: I gape for water and swallow only blood.

lines.zh: 疼得我乱摆尾，把沙全扬起来。
lines.en: Pain makes me thrash and kick up all the sand.

lines.zh: 我受伤后只想回到深一点的水。
lines.en: Wounded, I only want the deeper water.

lines.zh: 那钩上的虫在扭，我绕了三圈才靠近。
lines.en: The worm on the hook wriggles; I circle three times first.

lines.zh: 我闻到了腥味，尾巴自己就摆起来。
lines.en: I smell something bloody and my tail starts moving.

lines.zh: 亮片一闪，我当成了逃跑的小鱼。
lines.en: The spinner flashes; I take it for a fleeing minnow.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，那团东西还挂着。
lines.en: I open my mouth and close it; the morsel still hangs there.

lines.zh: 我明明知道有钩，还是绕回去了。
lines.en: I know there is a hook, and still I circle back.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰饵，试着咬一小口。
lines.en: I nudge the bait with my snout, then try a small bite.

lines.zh: 水里那点香味，让我忘了同伴。
lines.en: That little scent in the water makes me forget my school.

lines.zh: 钩子沉下去，我跟着它往深处走。
lines.en: The hook sinks and I follow it down deeper.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根线，忘了自己在下游。
lines.en: I stare at the line, forgetting I was downstream.

lines.zh: 我张口咬住的瞬间，水流忽然变紧。
lines.en: The moment I bite, the current pulls tight.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，鳞片蹭掉一点。
lines.en: I bump your boot and scrape off a scale or two.

lines.zh: 前面那块石头太近，我没来得及转弯。
lines.en: That rock was too close; I could not turn in time.

lines.zh: 同伴的尾巴打在我脸上，我晃了一下。
lines.en: A schoolmate's tail slaps my face; I wobble.

lines.zh: 撞上木桩后，我顺着水流退回来。
lines.en: After hitting the post, I drift back with the current.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过两块石头，只擦了一边。
lines.en: I squeeze between two stones, scraping one side.

lines.zh: 撞得不算重，我甩甩尾就游开了。
lines.en: It was not a hard knock; I flick my tail and go.

lines.zh: 我钻进桶口，身体被卡了一下。
lines.en: I dive into the bucket mouth and get caught briefly.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我，我整个人弹出去。
lines.en: Your hand brushes me and I bolt away whole.

lines.zh: 我撞到水底的卵石，扬起一层沙。
lines.en: I strike a river pebble and raise a puff of sand.

lines.zh: 我贴你太近，被你的影子吓了一跳。
lines.en: I got too close and your shadow startled me.

lines.zh: 春天到了，我顺着水找配对的那条。
lines.en: Spring has come; I swim upstream seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫出一小片干净的卵石。
lines.en: I sweep a small patch of pebbles clear with my tail.

lines.zh: 她游过来，我就把身子侧给她看。
lines.en: She swims near, so I turn my bright side to her.

lines.zh: 我们并排摆尾，让卵落进石缝里。
lines.en: We sway side by side, letting eggs fall into the gravel.

lines.zh: 虹带最亮的那条，被我先挑中了。
lines.en: The one with the brightest stripe caught me first.

lines.zh: 我守在这片浅滩，不让别的雄鱼靠近。
lines.en: I guard this shallow flat against other males.

lines.zh: 她撞我一下，我知道那是答应了。
lines.en: She bumps me once, and I know that is a yes.

lines.zh: 我们把卵埋好，然后一起往下游去。
lines.en: We bury the eggs, then drift downstream together.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转了两圈，才敢贴过去。
lines.en: I circle her twice before daring to come close.

lines.zh: 川水很凉，我们靠在一起也暖不起来。
lines.en: River water is cold; pressed together we still cannot warm.

lines.zh: 桶里水一晃，我的虹彩也跟着摇。
lines.en: The bucket water sloshes and my rainbow sways with it.

lines.zh: 我撞着桶壁，找不出一条缝。
lines.en: I knock the bucket wall, finding no seam to slip through.

lines.zh: 你提着我走，我听见外面的脚步。
lines.en: You carry me along; I hear footsteps outside.

lines.zh: 我在桶底转圈，鳃还在照常开合。
lines.en: I circle the bucket bottom, gills still working.

lines.zh: 从河到你家，我隔着桶听风声。
lines.en: From river to your house, I hear wind through the bucket.

lines.zh: 桶里水只有半满，我贴着最深处。
lines.en: The bucket is half full; I press against the deepest part.

lines.zh: 我倒进新水时，先甩了一下尾。
lines.en: Poured into new water, I flick my tail once.

lines.zh: 你把我举起来，我看见自己全是水光。
lines.en: You lift me up and I see myself all water-shine.

lines.zh: 桶盖一合，我知道这回游不掉了。
lines.en: The lid closes; I know I cannot swim out.

lines.zh: 我安静下来，等桶被放到水边。
lines.en: I calm down and wait for the bucket to reach water.

lines.zh: 水纹一变，我就把方向对准了那里。
lines.en: The ripple changes and I aim myself at it.

lines.zh: 有东西靠得太近，我盯住了那团影子。
lines.en: Something comes too near; I fix on that shadow.

lines.zh: 我先认出同伴的尾，再认出你的手。
lines.en: I recognize a schoolmate's tail first, then your hand.

lines.zh: 水里一线血味，我立刻转向了下游。
lines.en: A thread of blood in the water turns me downstream.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，准备朝那点闪光冲。
lines.en: I lower my head, ready to dart at the glint.

lines.zh: 目标很小，可我整条鱼都绷紧了。
lines.en: The target is small, yet my whole body goes taut.

lines.zh: 我绕到石头背面，从你视野外接近。
lines.en: I slide behind the stone and approach out of your sight.

lines.zh: 那群小鱼散了，我挑最慢的一条。
lines.en: The minnows scatter; I pick the slowest one.

lines.zh: 谁先动，我就先把谁记下来。
lines.en: Whoever moves first is the one I mark.

lines.zh: 我选好方向，尾巴先轻轻收了一下。
lines.en: I choose my line and draw my tail in slightly.

lines.zh: 我保持这个角度，一点点逼近。
lines.en: I hold this angle and close in little by little.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就跟着调整半寸。
lines.en: It moves, and I adjust by half an inch.

lines.zh: 我不急着咬，只跟着它绕石头。
lines.en: I do not bite yet; I just follow it around the rock.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住它，鳃却慢了半拍。
lines.en: My eyes are locked on it, though my gills slow.

lines.zh: 它往浅处逃，我顺着沙脊追。
lines.en: It flees to the shallows; I chase along the sand ridge.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底走，让影子留在后面。
lines.en: I keep to the bottom and leave my shadow behind.

lines.zh: 那东西停住了，我也停住不动。
lines.en: The thing stops, and I stop too.

lines.zh: 我数着它的摆尾，等它慢下来。
lines.en: I count its tailbeats, waiting for it to slow.

lines.zh: 距离缩到一尺，我还没出嘴。
lines.en: The gap shrinks to a foot and my mouth stays shut.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我的虹带跟着亮了一下。
lines.en: It turns, and my rainbow stripe flashes once.

lines.zh: 我冲上去，用吻部撞它的侧腹。
lines.en: I rush in and ram its flank with my snout.

lines.zh: 咬住之后我不松口，尾巴乱拍。
lines.en: Once I bite I hold on, tail slapping wildly.

lines.zh: 我把全身甩过去，鳞片刮出一道白痕。
lines.en: I throw my whole body across, scales leaving a white streak.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可我还是撞了第二下。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, yet I ram it again.

lines.zh: 我甩尾打它的眼，趁它一愣就退。
lines.en: I slap its eye with my tail, then retreat while it blinks.

lines.zh: 水里翻起泥沙，我们撞成一团。
lines.en: Mud swirls up as we crash into one knot.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍条，任它拖着走。
lines.en: I clamp its fin ray and let it drag me.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽力气，我自己也翻了。
lines.en: That blow took all my strength; I tumble too.

lines.zh: 我退开半尺，再找它软的地方。
lines.en: I back off a foot and look for a softer spot.

lines.zh: 打完了，我的鳃还在急急地动。
lines.en: The fight ends, and my gills still pump fast.

lines.zh: 我从河底的石缝里摆尾钻出来。
lines.en: I wiggle out of a crevice in the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水还凉，我先在原地转了一圈。
lines.en: The water is still cold; I turn once in place.

lines.zh: 四条同伴已经在等，我补上第五条。
lines.en: Four schoolmates already wait; I make us five.

lines.zh: 我生在上游，第一条试的是逆流。
lines.en: Born upstream, my first test is against the current.

lines.zh: 河流把我推了一寸，我就此认得它。
lines.en: The river pushes me an inch and I learn its name.

lines.zh: 我身上颜色还没长齐，先躲进阴影。
lines.en: My colors are not complete; I hide in the shade.

lines.zh: 春水刚化，我从卵石间冒出来。
lines.en: Spring melt just broke; I rise from the gravel.

lines.zh: 我睁眼看见的第一样，是桥的影子。
lines.en: The first thing I see is the bridge's shadow.

lines.zh: 我游出石缝，先跟上了最大那条。
lines.en: I leave the crevice and follow the largest fish.

lines.zh: 这条河今天多了一条虹鳟。
lines.en: This river holds one more rainbow trout today.

lines.zh: 火先烤熟了我的鳞，我才明白结局。
lines.en: Fire cooks my scales first, and I learn the ending.

lines.zh: 被甩到岸上，我在干石头上拍尾。
lines.en: Thrown onto the bank, I slap my tail on dry stone.

lines.zh: 泥沙塞住鳃，我连水都吸不进来。
lines.en: Silt clogs my gills; I cannot even draw water.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀出水面，又砸回去。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear of the water, then back down.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，钉住了我的侧鳍。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the water and pins my side fin.

lines.zh: 魔法在水里发亮，我的鳞全竖了起来。
lines.en: Magic glows in the water and every scale lifts.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连水草都去啃。
lines.en: Hungry too long, I even nibble at the weeds.

lines.zh: 雷落进溪里，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning lands in the stream and numbs me whole.

lines.zh: 石头下面空了，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The stone beneath me is gone; I keep falling.
